summary: Laurel, Maryland, software developer, climbing enthusiast (top-roping and bouldering), V3-V4 climber, advocates for Universal Basic Income (UBI), critical of political tribalism, interested in user experience (UX) design, values education and role models, skeptical of mainstream media, supports environmental sustainability, engaged in discussions about labor rights and unionization, interested in philosophy of science, has a nuanced view of Catholicism and science, enjoys podcasts, and has a critical perspective on the art market.
